Telescope.description: The 1-meter Boller & Chivens Ritchey-Chrétien reflector is an optical telescope located at the Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory in Chile, at coordinates -30.165222° latitude and 289.185608° longitude (J2000). Installed in 1974 and originally operated by Yale University Observatory, this 1-meter-class telescope has been used for a wide range of astronomical research, including photometric studies, stellar spectroscopy, and monitoring of variable stars. It remains an important facility for both research and education.
